def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find the solid line that divides the two panels.
    row_sep = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1), None)
    col_sep = next((c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1), None)
    if row_sep is not None:
        first = grid[:row_sep]
        second = grid[row_sep + 1:]
        height = min(len(first), len(second))
        width = w
        first, second = first[:height], second[:height]
    elif col_sep is not None:
        first = [row[:col_sep] for row in grid]
        second = [row[col_sep + 1:] for row in grid]
        height = h
        width = min(len(first[0]), len(second[0]))
    else:
        raise ValueError("No solid separator found")

    shared = set(x for row in first for x in row) & set(x for row in second for x in row)
    if len(shared) != 1:
        raise ValueError(f"Expected one color shared by the panels, got {shared}")
    color = next(iter(shared))
    return [[3 if first[r][c] == color and second[r][c] == color else color
             for c in range(width)] for r in range(height)]
